reason: I already only drink Zero versions and read every label, so a can with just water, mate and fruit concentrate and no sweeteners at all is exactly what I look for. 55 CZK doesn't matter to me, so I'd grab one at a café and order a few for exam nights if the taste works.
objection: Without any sugar or sweetener it might taste sour or bitter, and honestly a coffee or matcha does the same job, so it has to taste good enough to beat those.
would_change_my_mind: If the first can tastes flat or too bitter, I'd go back to coffee and Monster Ultra.
